payload.entry: Checking for earlier agent work before planning -r

Baseline: explicit sase-listen publish delivered the episode but left the source library manifest published:false in both roles (sase-listen ba0613d; only receive_episode, flush_pending, and render auto-publish marked). Fix: publish_any in src/sase_listen/feedhost.py now flips the source manifest via mark_manifest_published after every successful publish in both roles (new _mark_published_or_raise helper); a mark OSError/ValueError raises SaseListenError (exit 1, human+JSON) with a --pending hint in the remote role (run_publish queues it, so publish --pending retries the mark) and a rerun hint locally; delivery failures still leave published:false with unchanged outbox behavior. Removed the now-redundant mark in pipeline.py render auto-publish so publish_any is the single owner. Tests: 7 new tests in tests/test_feedhost.py (publish_any success local+remote, delivery failure both roles, mark failure both roles, CLI success, CLI mark-failure JSON, CLI remote mark-failure queues for --pending). sase tool run check passes (lint+full suite). Limitation: a local render auto-publish mark failure now surfaces through the generic 'Auto-publish skipped' warning (message body states the episode was delivered); visible and repairable, wording prefix slightly off. Target task bob-cli-c1 left open for the lander to verify.

Verified: new tests failed before the fix (6 failed) and pass after; tests/test_feedhost.py, test_feed.py, test_cli.py (73 passed) and test_pipeline.py, test_buildinfo.py (72 passed) green; sase tool run check (lint+full suite) succeeded. Explicit publish now marks the source manifest published:true in both roles; delivery failure leaves it false; mark failure exits 1 with human+JSON error and a repair path (queued --pending retry remotely, rerun locally).

Pruned .git during traversal in all ref_library snapshot walkers (migrate_tasks, migrate_zorg, show, list, find, today; rename and mod already pruned) so vanishing transient git files cannot panic the walk; replaced migrate_zorg's silent read-skip with expect so work-tree writes are never masked. No test compared raw .git bytes, so no rev-parse substitution was needed. Verified: cargo test --test cli ref_library green 4x incl. 3x --test-threads=64 (132 passed), just check exit 0.

payload.entry: Root cause: prepareForPresentation() calls inspectorRequested() unconditionally (RefsPanelModel.swift:862), which schedules a 120ms-debounce load in RefsInspectorLoader.schedule(); the loader had no visibility check, so the task fired ref show even while hidden. refreshInspectorAfterLibraryRefresh() was already guarded by panelIsVisible(), so the stale prepare-time task was the only stray path. Fix: loader gains shouldHydrate (default true), checked at fire time at top of load(); model wires it to panelIsVisible. Production show() still hydrates because the check runs 120ms later when the panel is visible. Test unchanged, assertion at full strength. Local evidence: just portable-check exit 0 (1648 Linux tests pass); mac scratch copy bundle.sh + just typecheck-tests PASS, scratch removed. Watch SHA: current bob-mac-capture master 8fda38d + this fix; flaky test testHiddenLibraryRefreshDoesNotHydrateInspector to be confirmed on macOS CI.

payload.entry: Baseline: draft_related_stays_under_the_debug_perf_gate timed one cold debug bob capture-related run over a 40-note x 38-task fixture against 500 ms; reports show 330-667 ms isolated and 0.78-1.22 s under parallel just check. Slowdown probe: temporary +2 ms/candidate sleep in draft_related failed the gate as required (min diff 3.27 s, all samples listed) and was reverted; product code untouched. payload.entry: Done: quiet EPIPE exit. Baseline repro on unpatched tree: bob stats -r 2026-01-01..2026-10-11 -f json | head -c 10 -> exit 101 plus thread-main panicked: failed printing to stdout: Broken pipe (os error 32). Fix in src/runner.rs: run_bob installs a conditional-silent panic hook plus catch_unwind around run_bob_inner; is_epipe_print_panic maps only stdout/stderr failed-printing + BrokenPipe payloads to exit 0, everything else rethrown after hook restore (message + 101 preserved). No SIGPIPE change (grep confirms no new signal calls). Also maps BrokenPipe from root clap error.print to 0 and capture-expand write_all BrokenPipe to quiet 0. Tests: 2 new classifier unit tests (accept stdout/stderr EPIPE incl. &str payload; reject ENOSPC print failure, unrelated panic, non-string payload) and tests/cli/epipe.rs regression (349KB fixture, 10-byte read then close, asserts exit 0 and no panicked/Broken pipe on stderr). Verified: repro now exit 0 empty stderr; closed-stderr variant exit 0; full stats output intact (353663B); bob --help | head and stats --help | head exit 0 empty stderr incl. 20/20 loop; bogus subcommand still exit 2. Gates: cargo fmt clean, clippy exit 0, full cargo test --no-fail-fast green (18 suites ok, 0 failed). No docs exit-status contract exists so no docs change. No follow-ups discovered.
EPIPE exits quietly: repro now exit 0 with empty stderr; classifier unit tests + committed tests/cli/epipe.rs regression green; fmt/clippy/full cargo test green
